title: Existence of a complete devissage after one elementary etale localization
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness), section 'The local structure of a finite type module'
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts the existence of a whole family of etale morphisms h_i : Y_i -> X_{S'} over one elementary etale neighbourhood (S', s') -> (S, s), each Y_i carrying a complete devissage of the pullback of F and collectively covering the fibre X_s (statement lines 1580-1585). The non-routine step is the passage from the pointwise existence of a devissage at every x in X_s, which the author has available at each single point, to a single base change that works for all of them at once: the fibre must first be made finite using openness of the elementary etale morphisms and quasi-compactness of X_s, and the finitely many bases S'_i then have to be multiplied together over S before the base change lemma can be applied to every i simultaneously (proof lines 1598-1616). The author's own lead-in at source line 1573 calls this step bookkeeping, so the difficulty is the fibre-product bookkeeping rather than a new construction, which places it at H2.
